label: Small test — XYZ-SP500 vs US500 (1x)
description: A small, 1x preset to test XYZ-SP500/USDC:USDC vs MT5 US500: 0.1 units per level = a 0.1-lot US500 hedge (about 670 USD); two grid levels per side, so at most 0.2 units each way; isolated margin; daily loss capped at 25 USD and 10,000 USD of volume per leg. Sizes assume a broker whose minimum lot is the usual one — Save checks them against the market the bot reports; start in DRY RUN.
